title: Searching your life
summary: You search Life for “dinner with Omar”. Kumo answers first, from what memory's search found: Orrin's, last Friday, and what you wrote about the fig thing. Under it come the days (Friday, and a dinner in October), Orrin's, known from Friday's photos, and Omar, with when you last saw him. You search again and the answer comes as it was, kept, with no new call to the model.
